notes.title: Spoiler Alert is 67% off
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6240080/cac77ba50251963f95fe24015bb2440f8243dba7.gif[/img]

[h3]WARNING! Spoilers ahead! [i][b]Spoiler Alert[/b][/i], a [b]reverse[/b] comedy platformer, is on sale with the [u]67%[/u] discount:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/283230/Spoiler_Alert/

[b]Hurry! The deal ends on March 16th![/b]

notes.title: Spoiler Alert live with Steam-exclusive content!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/SeQuKKV.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

Spoiler Alert is finally live! Yeah! 

Steam-exclusive features include

[list]
[*]Level editor with Steam Workshop 
[*]The original soundtrack, including a new bonus track and deleted tracks 
[*]The original Game Jam version of Spoiler Alert - see how it all began 
[*]Exclusive hi-res desktop art and concept art 
[*]Screensavers, deleted graphics, and more![/list]

You can find them in the additional content in the game-folder :) 

Here is a bonus launch-day trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5X8UcpcGQBI
